3 Simple Steps for Credential Evaluations at AET

1. Based on your purpose (employment, immigration, education, etc.), decide the type of evaluation.
2. Click here to download and complete the application form.
3. Email the form and other required documents to info@americantranslationservice.com.

Required documents include degree certificates or diplomas plus certified English translations; add transcripts and translations if you need course-by-course evaluation. Contact us for further questions.

3 Easy Steps for Certified Translations at AET

1. Email photocopies of your documents to info@americantranslationservice.com.
2. Receive an official quote with processing time and payment options.
3. Submit payment and wait for delivery.

More about AET's services

Foreign Credential Evaluation

Foreign Credential Evaluation (aka Evaluation of Educational Credentials) helps foreign nationals seeking work authorization (H1B), immigration status, employment, education, military recruitment, and more. Contact us for a free estimate!

ATA-Certified Translations

A certified translation consists of the original source text, the translated text, a signed statement of accuracy (often titled "Certificate of Accuracy"), and notarization—ATA-certified translators can add their stamp. Contact us for a free estimate!
